runs.question: How long do CFO Act agencies have to publish an AI strategy under the OMB AI memos?

answer.text:
Under the current OMB memo, CFO Act agencies have **180 days** from the memo's issuance to develop an AI strategy. M-25-21 is the governing document. Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to their responsible use of AI and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of their applications.

The earlier memo set a longer window. M-24-10 gave CFO Act agencies 365 days of the issuance of this memorandum to develop and release a strategy. M-25-21 supersedes it: this memorandum rescinds and replaces Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Memorandum M-24-10, so the 180-day deadline is the one that applies.

Two limits on scope apply. The requirement applies to CFO Act agencies except for the Department of Defense, and does not apply to elements of the Intelligence Community. Strategies also must use the AI Strategies template, to be provided by OMB, and make their AI Strategies publicly available.

The M-25-21 summary table on page 25 lists the deadlines in a garbled layout, so I relied on the body text for the 180-day figure.
